subject:
[Contribution Opportunity] Migrate remaining providers to
 `common.compat` compatibility layer

messages.subject:
[Contribution Opportunity] Migrate remaining providers to
 `common.compat` compatibility layer
messages.body:
Hello folks,

We need community help to migrate remaining provider packages to use the
compat layer in `common.compat` provider.

Details in https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/57018

The above issue contains helpful references and steps which could be used
with any AI tool too to get good results. But of course review it first
before creating PRs :).

Thanks, looking forward for contributions.

Regards,
Kaxil
